mines.mine_notes: 2025 flotation plant processed 3,001,521 t ore, producing 66,171 dmt gold concentrates at ~19.4 g/t; Knelson gravity + heap leach produced 2,513.60 kg gold doré at 80.88% gold, sold to an Australian refinery. Contained gold sold: doré 2,273.60 kg (1,828 kg Au) + concentrates 57,860.90 t (1,101 kg Au) = 2,929 kg Au (94,169 oz). Flotation recovery >80%; capacity reached 12,000 tpd by Dec 2025. Reserve price US$3,200/oz. Mining right 15 years to 2034; commercial operations since 2022. Per-mine AISC not disclosed.
mines.processing: Open-pit mine on Guadalcanal; flotation plant (500 m³ cell installed July 2025) + Knelson gravity circuit + heap leach; products gold doré (~80% Au) and gold concentrates

mines.mine_notes: Underground Cu-Pb-Zn-Fe-S polymetallic mine (Jiangxi). 900,000 tpa mining and processing capacity (safety production certificate obtained 2023). Copper-iron processing plant suspended 67 days in H1 2025 for technical transformation; upgraded to 800,000 tpa. Products: copper, iron, zinc, sulfur and lead concentrates with gold and silver by-products. Per-mine gold production not disclosed; gold by-product revenue included in 'gold in lead/copper/zinc concentrates' lines (RMB95.6M in 2025).
mines.processing: Underground mining; copper-iron and polymetallic processing plants; 900,000 tpa capacity

mines.mine_notes: Lead-silver mine in Walege, Karuo District, Changdu City, Tibet. Not yet producing: 1.2 Mtpa lead mining and beneficiation project in permitting (site selection opinion letter issued 11 August 2025). 2025 activities limited to exploration licence maintenance and environmental baseline sampling. Group holds 51% attributable interest in Xizang Changdu County Dadi Mining Co., Ltd.

notes: Renamed from Wanguo International Mining Group Limited to Wanguo Gold Group Limited. FY2025 revenue RMB3,161.2M (+68.5%), profit attributable to owners RMB1,355.0M (+135.5%), gross margin 74.3%; growth driven by higher gold sales volumes and prices at Gold Ridge. Segments: Yifeng Project (Xinzhuang concentrates) and Solomon Project (Gold Ridge doré/concentrates). 2025 revenue mix: gold doré RMB1,556.2M, gold concentrates RMB884.7M. Group owns 88.2% of Gold Ridge Mine (98% of AXF Gold Ridge Pty Ltd, which owns 90%). Processing technical service contract with Xiamen Zijin Mining & Metallurgy Technology (Zijin MMT) for Gold Ridge. Gold Ridge reserve estimate updated 15 March 2026 (SLR Consulting, JORC 2012): resources 12,970 koz (403.4 t), reserves 7,777 koz (241.9 t), +79.7%/+550.1% YoY. Chairman Gao Mingqing (25.57% shareholder via Victor Soar Investments). Reporting currency RMB. Company does not disclose AISC.

reserves_resources.notes: Open-pit reserve; 37.0 Mt proved at 0.94 + 205.6 Mt probable at 1.01. Reserve price US$3,200/oz. Reported at 100% equity stake (group effective interest 88.2%).

464.9 Mt total resource (measured 40.6 Mt at 0.92, indicated 245.1 Mt at 0.96, inferred 179.3 Mt at 0.73). Cut-off 0.23-0.26 g/t in US$4,200 pit shell; 1 g/t below shell. Reported at 100% equity stake.
